doc_friction.issue: Reported 'no earlier perf pass on record' for gaussian-process-regression although ci-perf-2026-11-14-gaussian-process-... covers it: the history match needs the full slug in the file name or title. Named this run's write-up with the slug and left the heuristic alone (its docstring explains the false positives a looser match caused).

--for-changes stops at the post front-matter check before the sweep (description 173 > 160 chars). That is useful, but on a first pass it costs a full rerun; check_post_frontmatter could be run first on its own.

notes: Metric: wall time of a scratch bench (analyze on the Mauna Loa example with smooth-quasiperiodic + 2 predictions, auto over all seven kernels, auto on 60 irregular points; sha256 over JSON of all three), node 22, 4 cores. Before 15.5-15.9 s, after 10.7 s, hash 09dcbf6830701fe4 both. Steps: reuse factor 15.5->13.3 s; 2-column Cholesky ->12.3 s; 2x4 inverse ->10.7 s. CLI four runs concatenated sha256 3ee6a8c6... identical, 32.2 s -> 23.0 s. run_venture_tests.py gaussian-process-regression 12.0 s -> 8.5 s (49 -> 50 tests). Per file alone: engine.test 12.3 -> 9.8 s, cli.test 5.5 -> 4.1 s. Mutant dropping a tile term fails 12 tests; mutant removing the reuse guard survives (path unreached by fixtures), noted in the write-up. Local checks: run_workflow_locally --for-changes: 8/8 selected workflows passed (uses: steps, agent-cross-review and deploy jobs not run locally).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: profile, two bit-identical loop tilings with tests, one reuse change, write-up and post for a senior numerical engineer

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
